name: images-slider
title: Images Slider
description: A full-screen photo carousel where each landscape image tips and slides out while the next scales up from a tilted card. A dark overlay holds a white headline and a small pill button still.
use: A travel, venue or product hero where big photography should rotate behind one fixed message.
avoid: Many large photos: every image is loaded up front, so bandwidth cost is high.
a11y: Arrow keys work, but there are no visible controls, images have no alt text, and autoplay cannot be paused. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-bleed landscape photograph fills the panel under a dark overlay, with a white two-line headline and a small outlined pill button centred on top. In transition the next image appears as a tilted rectangle at an edge.
behaves: Every five seconds the current photo tips and slides out while the next scales in from a rotated card. The left and right arrow keys move back and forward, and the headline overlay stays fixed.
customise: Pass an images array, overlay content as children, a direction and autoplay; the overlay darkness and slide motion are fixed.
weight: moderate: Preloads every photo at full size and animates large scaled images.
demo: Mountain, beach, tent and lake photos; headline Places worth the long flight.
issues: No visible next or previous controls, so only arrow keys navigate.
Autoplay runs on a fixed five-second timer and cannot be paused.
Photos have no alt text for screen readers.
polishWhy: Rich photography and a smooth tilt transition; no visible controls or pause.
